skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Characteristics of Common Law System
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the distinctive features of the common law system compared to the Vietnamese legal system.
Analyze differences between the two legal systems in areas such as criminal law, civil law, business forms, contracts, and legal professions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Using Legal English in Professional Contexts
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply legal English skills in professional settings.
Analyze and evaluate legal fields within the common law system and the Vietnamese legal system.
Develop the ability to independently research, study, accumulate, and enhance professional knowledge.
Develop the initiative to present research results actively.
